questions.question: What can cause the voltage across reactances in a series RLC circuit to be higher than the voltage applied to the entire circuit?
What is the resonant frequency of an RLC circuit if R is 22 ohms, L is 50 microhenries, and C is 40 picofarads?
What is the magnitude of the impedance of a series RLC circuit at resonance?

choices.A: High, compared to the circuit resistance

questions.question: What is the magnitude of the impedance of a parallel RLC circuit at resonance?

choices.C: Low compared to the circuit resistance
choices.D: High compared to the circuit resistance

questions.question: What is the result of increasing the Q of an impedance-matching circuit?
What is the magnitude of the circulating current within the components of a parallel LC circuit at resonance?

choices.C: It equals 1 divided by the quantity 2 times pi, times the square root of (inductance L multiplied by capacitance C)
choices.D: It equals 2 times pi, times the square root of (inductance L multiplied by capacitance C)

questions.question: What is the magnitude of the current at the input of a parallel RLC circuit at resonance?
What is the phase relationship between the current through and the voltage across a series resonant circuit at resonance?

choices.A: The voltage leads the current by 90 degrees
choices.B: The current leads the voltage by 90 degrees
choices.C: The voltage and current are in phase
choices.D: The voltage and current are 180 degrees out of phase

questions.answer: The voltage and current are in phase

questions.question: How is the Q of an RLC parallel resonant circuit calculated?

choices.A: Reactance of either the inductance or capacitance divided by the resistance
choices.B: Reactance of either the inductance or capacitance multiplied by the resistance
choices.C: Resistance divided by the reactance of either the inductance or capacitance
choices.D: Reactance of the inductance multiplied by the reactance of the capacitance

questions.answer: Resistance divided by the reactance of either the inductance or capacitance

choices.A: Fewer components are needed for the same performance
